page.layout: Two columns of a Hebrew word-list, side by side on one page, read left column then right. Running head "y" over each column; page number 173 top right. Catchword "Rad." at the foot of the right column; signature "Y 3" at the foot of the left column.

main_text.l: & supplantavit me, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. aff. Rad. עָקַב.
וַיַּעְקֵר & enervavit, fut. Piel, 3. f. m. R. עָקַר.
וַיַּעְקְשֵׁנִי & pervertit me, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. præf. aff. R. עָקַשׁ.
וַיַּעַר et excitabit, וַיַּעַר et excitavit, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. præf. Rad. עוּר.
יַעַרְבוּ vel יַעַרְכוּ miscebunt, fut. Kal, 3. pl. m. à 3. f. m. יַעַרֵב, vel יַעַרֵב miscebit, Rad. עָרַב.
יַעֲרָה effundetur, fut. Niph. 3. f. m. R. עָרָה.
יַעְרִי silva ejus (viri) יַעְרָה silva ejus (fœminæ) יַעְרַי mea, יַעֲרִים silvæ, f. m. aff. & pl. m. à f. m. No. R. יַעַר silva.
יַעוּרוּ excitabuntur, fut. Niph. 3. pl. m. R. עוּר.
Piel, 3. pl. m. præf. à 3. f. m. יַעֲרָה effundet, Rad. עָרָה.
יַעֲרִיכֶנּוּ æstimabit eum, fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. aff. Rad. עָרַךְ.
יַעֲרִיצוּ formidabunt, fut. Hiph. 3. pl. m. R. עָרַץ.
יַעַרְכֶנּוּ disponet eum, יַעַרְכוּנִי disponent contra me, fut. Kal, 3. f. & pl. m. aff. à 3. f. m. יַעַרְךָ; Rad. עָרַךְ.
יַעֲרֹךְ decollabit, יַעַרְכוּ decollabunt, fut. Kal. 3. f. & pl. m. Rad. עָרַךְ.
יַעֲרַת favus, sing. fœm. constr. No. יַעֲרַת à No. Rad. יַעַר.
יַעֲשֶׂה faciet, וַיַּעַשׂ et fecit, fut. Kal, 3. f. m. apoc. pro יַעֲשֶׂה, Rad. עָשָׂה.
וַיַּעַשׁ et involavit, et amicivit se, pro וַיַּעֲטֹ fut. Kal, 3. f. m. apoc. pro וַיַּעֲטֶה à Rad. עָטָה: vel fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. Rad.

page.notes: The Hebrew vowel pointing in this word-list is faint and partly damaged by the scan; forms marked by no [?] were read with reasonable confidence, but the exact pointing of the Hebrew forms (e.g. the vowel signs in יַעֲרִיצוּ, וַיַּעַשׁ, וַיַּעֲטֹ) may not be reliable. The right-column entry "Piel, 3. pl. m. præf." continues the left-column entry "וַיַּעֲרוּ et effundent, fut." across the column break. The line "vel fut. Hiph. 3. f. m. Rad." ends at the foot of the page and the word after "Rad." is the catchword. The running head reads "y" over each column, which is the Hebrew letter yod printed as a Latin y with a comma. No marginal notes, no reference marks and no blank lines of text were found on this page.
